action: High Court orders DoE to run mobile courts twice a week against air polluters in Dhaka; fence construction/repair sites within 15 days; spray dust-prone areas twice a day
notes: FE: 'The High Court on Monday ordered…' (28 Jan 2019 was a Monday). Same-day report.

action: High Court summons DoE air quality management director (appear 10 April) and orders DoE to report on steps taken; city corporations to report
notes: banglanews24: 'on Wednesday (Mar 13)'. Followed a 6 March news report ranking Dhaka second-worst for air.

action: High Court summons CEOs of Dhaka North and South City Corporations to explain air pollution steps (appear 15 May)
notes: Prothom Alo: 'on Sunday' (5 May 2019 was a Sunday). DECISION: kept, but summonses are weaker than orders; tool marked 'Court order (summons)' so they can be dropped in a robustness check.

action: High Court orders mobile court drives to shut all illegal brick kilns in Dhaka, Narayanganj, Gazipur, Munshiganj and Manikganj within 15 days; road dust removal in 7 days; water spraying twice a day; high-powered committee
notes: CORRECTED from 25 Nov: FE says 'on Tuesday' (26 Nov 2019). Daily Star print 'yesterday' = 26 Nov. A later Daily Star report (6 Jan 2020) also gives 26 Nov.

action: DoE mobile court demolishes illegal brick kilns in Namagenda, Savar (TB Brick Kiln and four others), fines Tk 23 lakh
notes: Both reports are Daily Star, so only one independent outlet. Lead: Financial Express 'DoE shuts illegal brick kilns, fines Tk 18 million in Savar' (date not yet checked).

action: DoE mobile court fines four kilns Tk 22 lakh in Kandapara, South Keraniganj; reports 200 of 250 Keraniganj kilns bulldozed
notes: UNB: 'on Sunday at 11am' (5 Jan 2020 was a Sunday). Prothom Alo carries the same headline, probably the UNB wire story, so it does not count as independent.

action: DoE reports to the High Court that all illegal brick kilns in the five districts around Dhaka have been shut
notes: A report of closures, not the closures themselves; actual shutdown dates unknown. Within 30 days of E06 and E08.

action: High Court nine-point directive: shut remaining illegal kilns in 5 districts within 2 months, seize black-smoke vehicles, cover trucks and construction materials, water spraying, vehicle age limits, and more
notes: DT: 'issued nine directives on Monday' (13 Jan 2020 was a Monday). Published late afternoon, so 14 Jan is the first 'after' day. Most-cited event in the case.

action: High Court orders five executive magistrates deployed under DoE within a month to run mobile courts against pollution
notes: TBS page shows no date, so it cannot confirm the day. Within 30 days of E08.

action: High Court orders authorities to implement the nine-point directive within 30 days
notes: DT: 'on Tuesday' (24 Nov 2020 was a Tuesday). Daily Star (Feb 2021) also says 'November 24 last year'.

action: DoE announces drive to demolish about 700 illegal brick kilns (400 around Dhaka); 30 kilns near Dhaka demolished the week before; mobile courts to continue 2–3 months
notes: Date is the announcement (DT posted just after midnight, so news from 11 Jan). The drive was already underway; test 4 Jan 2021 as an alternative start in a robustness check.

action: High Court issues three new directives, including regular water spraying on city roads and road-island trees
notes: RESOLVED: TBS and FE both say 'on Thursday' (4 Feb 2021). Daily Star print 'yesterday' also = 4 Feb (print edition of 5 Feb).

action: DoE mobile court demolishes six brick kilns in Namagenda and Birulia, Savar, fines Tk 62 lakh
notes: Single outlet so far.

action: High Court orders all illegal brick kilns in Dhaka, Gazipur, Manikganj, Narayanganj and Munshiganj demolished within 15 days
notes: Both say 'on Tuesday' (1 Mar 2022 was a Tuesday). Daily Star print 'yesterday' also = 1 Mar.

action: High Court summons DoE Director General and DCs of Dhaka and four districts (appear 17 May) for failing to shut illegal kilns
notes: FE: 'on Wednesday' (20 Apr 2022 was a Wednesday). FE notes 318 illegal kilns were still operating.

action: DoE tells the High Court that 314 of 411 illegal kilns in the five districts were shut since November 2021
notes: A report of closures over Nov 2021 – May 2022, not a single action.

action: Air Pollution (Control) Rules 2022 issued (SRO No. 255)
notes: DECISION: excluded from the main analysis. The SRO is dated 25 Jul 2022, but the Daily Star said in Feb 2023 that the gazette was 'recent', and rules take effect gradually, so there is no clear single date.

action: High Court asks DoE, city corporations and fire service to report the steps taken under its directives by 5 February
notes: Both say 'on Tuesday'; petition filed Monday 30 Jan, so hearing 31 Jan 2023. Daily Star print 'yesterday' also = 31 Jan.

action: High Court orders all authorities to implement its directives within two weeks and warns it will summon officials ('You are killing us')
notes: FE: hearing on 5 Feb (Sunday). Daily Star print 'yesterday' = 5 Feb. Cluster with E18 and E20.

action: DoE special drives in Savar, Sabujbagh, Mirpur, Bhatara and Lalbagh fine 15 vehicles and 12 organisations for air and noise pollution
notes: DT: 'on Monday' (6 Feb 2023 was a Monday).

action: Environment ministry starts a month-long mobile court drive in Dhaka against air and noise pollution
notes: UNB: 'from Wednesday' (5 Apr 2023 was a Wednesday). Lead: Prothom Alo 'Seven vehicles, six brick kilns fined for polluting air' may report this drive.

action: DoE mobile court shuts four illegal kilns in South Keraniganj, razes Noor Bricks chimney, fines Tk 64 lakh
notes: UNB: 'on Thursday' (8 Feb 2024 was a Thursday). TBS page shows no date, so it cannot confirm the week.

action: Environment adviser announces task force on dust, scrapping of old polluting buses and a no-kiln zone in Ashulia
notes: Observer: 'on Thursday' (19 Dec 2024 was a Thursday). Plans only, no action that day.

action: DoE begins a nationwide special anti-pollution drive (mobile courts, kiln closures; ran to 10 Apr, later extended)
notes: Start date comes from later campaign summaries ('from 2 January'); a Dhaka Tribune report (12 Sep 2025) gives the same start. Within 30 days of E25.

action: High Court orders effective steps within seven days and a compliance report by 23 January
notes: Both say 'on Sunday' (12 Jan 2025 was a Sunday). Monitor data ends 24 Mar 2025, so the 30-day window after is covered.

action: DoE declares Savar a 'degraded air shed'; all kilns except tunnel and hybrid Hoffman kilns banned from September
notes: After the monitor data ends. Keep for a future Savar test using the AirGradient sensors (15462183, 15677432).

action: DoE runs multiple mobile court drives nationwide against air pollution
notes: After the monitor data ends.

action: High Court orders full implementation of the nine-point directive within three weeks
notes: After the monitor data ends.
